name: AABB Intersection via Face Traversal
definition: A method to find the entry (front) and exit (back) points of a ray intersecting an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box by testing the ray against each of the six faces of the AABB.
summary: AABB Intersection via Face Traversal determines ray entry and exit points by explicitly testing against each of the six box faces, distinguishing itself from the slab method through geometric decomposition at higher computational cost.
